baseline_prompt_en: A complex photographic scene holds one coherent moment with a fictional adult woman in a theater prop repair room just after the final curtain. The supplied image guides her visible face and hair appearance: a short dark bob, airy divided bangs, soft oval face, large dark almond eyes, small nose and full lips. Across a scarred worktable, she briefly looks up toward the photographer with an unforced, slightly parted-lip expression while finishing a small repair. Her dark satin blouse has an open neckline and sleeves pushed back from the wrists. Both forearms rest lightly on the tabletop; her right fingertips rest on a domed red enamel paperweight seated fully on the curling corner of a hand-painted scenery plan, while her left palm spreads its opposite edge flat. A previously rolled portion still arcs upward behind the flattened corner. Curtain folds and rolled scenery lean against the distant wall, placing this private working pause after a public performance. A chest-height three-quarter view from the opposite side shows her face, both connected arms, the paper and weight together; her face and working hands lead the frame. Render the entire picture in true grayscale except the single red enamel paperweight, which retains saturated crimson. The darkest hair and shelving tones sit at soft charcoal gray with readable strand and wood detail, while highlights roll smoothly. Local dodge-and-burn evens the larger cheek tones while fine pores and tiny natural skin variations remain clearly visible. Broad side window light shapes her face and the table; the background recedes gently while her eyes, cheeks and fingertips remain crisp.
